title: Business Analyst - Government
text: Business Analyst - Government at Horizon Consulting (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Horizon Consulting are looking for a self-motivated and highly skilled Business Analyst to join a NSW Government organisation to work across an ongoing project of work. Key Skills: 5+ years Microsoft Access 2010 application development experience Competency in SQL Server – T-SQL, pass through queries, views, nuances of table linkage from Access Experience in a team MS Access / SQL Server development environment Experienced in MS Excel and spreadsheet development and analysis Complete familiarity with Relational database design, Access to SQL Server upsizing, data migration, linking multiple data sources. Very high-level VBA knowledge and application experience Advanced Form creation, knowledge of reporting Ability to create ERD diagrams, Work Flow diagrams, procedures, test plans. Excellent written and verbal communication Key Accountabilities: Technical skills and expertise to assess, research and analyse business and system needs. Proactive problem-solver. Organized with good time management skills - Business acumen. Strategic influencing - Can deal with ambiguity and manage change effectively Able to switch tasks, respond to new priorities, and function independently if necessary. Can adapt quickly and positively to changes. Flexible with regard to evaluation and adoption of best practice and in-house standards and architectures for documentation, coding, build/release and testing. Creative thinker, breakthrough, innovative, out of the box thinker. Team player, cooperative, with good interpersonal skills If you are looking for a challenging role in an organisation where you can make an impact, then i would love to hear from you.
